title: Require the later check's own refusal cause in the compound-terminal regression
outcome: The compound terminal regression asserts SECOND's own was-still-running cause rather than a generic overlap phrase from either command.
acceptance: The assertion ties SECOND's fingerprint to its own was-still-running refusal explanation, retaining the existing no-SECOND-evidence assertion.
The regression still fails if the simple-command early-terminal guard is removed.
